comment: Independent invent.c merged() comparison discovery from a live hold_another_object(). A debug-mode Monk wishes for an uncursed horn of plenty with 20 charges and applies it fifteen times, ESC dismissing each --More--. mkobj.c hornoplenty() hands each spilled food to hold_another_object(); when it stacks with the Monk's starting food, whose curse state is known, merged() prints 'You learn more about your items by comparing them.' before it frees the incoming object.
